entries.title: C++ single-case scaffold
entries.strategy: Fast I/O, common macros (ll, pii, all, loop), one solve() call.
entries.reuse: Problem with exactly one test case.

entries.title: C++ multi-case scaffold
entries.strategy: Same as single-case; reads t and loops solve().
entries.reuse: T test cases follow style problems.

entries.title: Python scaffold
entries.strategy: Buffered I/O, raised recursion limit, input helpers, optional input.txt.
entries.reuse: Any Python problem, single or multi-test.

entries.title: Binary search on answer
entries.strategy: BS over answer with monotone feasibility predicate try(t).
entries.reuse: Min/max value with monotone check (time, capacity, threshold).

entries.title: Ternary search (floating)
entries.strategy: Split [l,r] in thirds, discard worse third, epsilon-terminated.
entries.reuse: Extremum of strictly unimodal continuous function.

entries.title: Merge sort
entries.strategy: Divide-and-conquer, O(n log n), stable.

entries.title: Counting sort
entries.strategy: Bucket histogram, O(n + max).

entries.title: Bubble sort
entries.strategy: Repeated adjacent swaps, O(n^2).

entries.title: Distinct numbers
entries.strategy: Sort then single pass counting first occurrence.

entries.title: Sum of two values
entries.strategy: Sort with indices, two-pointer sweep from both ends toward target.
entries.reuse: Pair with sum = k; problems needing original indices.

entries.title: Black and white stripes (fixed window)
entries.strategy: Fixed-size sliding window k, update count on entry/exit.

entries.title: Apple division (subset partition)
entries.strategy: Enumerate all 2^n subsets, minimize partition diff.

entries.title: Hamiltonian flights (bitmask DP)
entries.strategy: DP over (current node, visited mask), memoized, mod 1e9+7.

entries.title: Tree diameter
entries.strategy: DFS tracking longest depth per node; diameter = sum of two best child depths.
entries.reuse: Diameter / longest path in unweighted tree, single traversal.

entries.title: Huffman code cost
entries.strategy: Greedy multiset merge of two smallest frequencies; accumulate cost.
entries.reuse: Optimal prefix code, connect ropes, merge stones.

entries.title: Euler tour (tin/tout)
entries.strategy: DFS timestamps; subtree becomes contiguous interval.
entries.reuse: Combine with segtree/BIT for subtree updates and queries.

entries.title: Subtree sizes
entries.strategy: Post-order DFS; each node's size = sum of (child + 1).

entries.title: Sum of distances (rerooting)
entries.strategy: First DFS computes answer from root; second reroots in O(n).

entries.title: BST traversals
entries.strategy: Recursive insert; pre/in/post-order print.

entries.title: Dijkstra
entries.strategy: Min-heap SSSP with lazy visited flag.
entries.reuse: SSSP with non-negative weights, O((V+E) log V).

entries.title: Floyd-Warshall
entries.strategy: Triple loop over intermediate k; O(V^3).
entries.reuse: All-pairs shortest paths, V <= ~400, handles negative edges.

entries.title: BFS distance
entries.strategy: Queue-based shortest hop distance in unweighted graph.

entries.title: Bipartite check (2-coloring)
entries.strategy: BFS 2-color per component; same-colored neighbor = odd cycle.

entries.title: Connected components
entries.strategy: BFS from every unvisited node, collect components.

entries.title: Kadane (max subarray sum)
entries.strategy: Running sum reset when extending is worse than restarting.

entries.title: Diagonal path count (memoized)
entries.strategy: Top-down recursion with map memo; grid paths = binomial coeff.
entries.reuse: Template for 2-parameter memoized DP with map cache.

entries.title: Dynamic range sum queries
entries.strategy: Recursive segtree: point-assign update, range-sum query, O(log n). VERIFY update sibling-index before reuse.
entries.reuse: Point update + range sum; use Fenwick if merge is just sum.

entries.title: Gale-Shapley (C++)
entries.strategy: Proposers propose in preference order; receivers keep best via rank map.

entries.title: Gale-Shapley (Python)
entries.strategy: Compact port of Gale-Shapley using deque of free proposers.
entries.reuse: Python readability version of the C++ above.
